intro:
## Submit Your Data to Sourdough for Science

Thank you for participating in Sourdough for Science. Your measurements will help solve the mystery of bread, by quantifying how different flours contribute to the growth of each "microbial zoo" and how those microbes contribute to the taste and texture of bread.
aside:
![container with bacteria, yeast and flour and a baked loaf of bread](/-static/img/forms/sourdough-for-science.jpg)

*Lauren Nichols, Neil McCoy*

Presented by the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences and North Carolina State University.
